tagline: One thing worth knowing, only when it matters

cost.summary: Off by default, no model call. The `Check while Claude works` setting turns on a side check that asks your session's model about the session, at most once per turn.
readme: By default this mod makes no model call. Turn on Check while Claude works (`/mod-heads-up settings`) and it calls a model, which spends tokens and counts against your plan quota.

- **The side check:** on every sixth step of the main agent, at most once per turn and never while a note card is showing, the mod asks a model to read the session. It forks your session when its effort is low or medium, which reuses the cached conversation. At a higher effort, or with nothing to fork yet, it sends the whole conversation to your session's model at medium effort. If a newer step may have overtaken the finding, it asks once more before showing it.
- **Reword:** each click on simpler words, less detail or more detail makes one more call.
- **Off by default:** with Check while Claude works off, the side check makes no request. Reword only runs when you click it.

features.title: A side check
features.detail: Every sixth step of a long turn, at most once per turn, a check reads the session and flags one thing you should understand and probably missed. Most checks show nothing.

features.title: A card above the prompt
features.detail: The note shows with its tag, You should know or Heads up, and says who decided. Open shows it in the panel, × dismisses it.

features.title: The Heads up panel
features.detail: Every note of the session under its turn, opened in place, with Got it, Ask Claude and Reword (simpler words, less detail or more detail). Hover any control for what it does.

features.title: Last turn
features.detail: Hover the Heads up pill after a turn to see what the whole turn did: how long it took, the subagents it started, its edits and tool errors, and how much the session cost grew. Before the first turn ends, the tip says what the mod does.

features.title: Command hooks
features.detail: On SessionStart, a small shell hook appends the event's JSON as one line to `~/.claude/mods-data/mod-heads-up/bridge/<session id>.jsonl` (under `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` when that is set), and the mod reads the file every 250 ms. A record can hold the session id, the working folder and the transcript path. SessionEnd deletes the session's file, and SessionStart deletes files older than 7 days. The hooks need a POSIX shell (Git Bash on Windows). Without one they write nothing, and the mod falls back to what it can find on its own. Some plans block plugin hooks on these events; the mod then falls back the same way.
